final: WITH c AS (SELECT d.district_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A3), r AS (SELECT district_id, region, cnt, AVG(cnt * 1.0) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS region_avg FROM c), h AS (SELECT * FROM r WHERE cnt > region_avg) SELECT district_id, region, cnt AS account_count, cnt - region_avg AS above_region_avg, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) FROM h) AS ratio_to_overall_avg FROM h ORDER BY ratio_to_overall_avg DESC LIMIT 10
